  COMPANY OVERVIEW
═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

Company Name: Danyang Blue Star Anti-corrosion Cleaning Co., Ltd.
Chinese Name: 丹阳市蓝星防腐清洗有限公司
Short Name: Blue Star Cleaning / 丹阳蓝星清洗
Founded: 2001
Location: No. 98 Hongjiadai, Picheng, Danbei Town, Danyang City, Jiangsu Province, China
Industry: Industrial Equipment Cleaning & Anti-corrosion Services
Membership: China Industrial Cleaning Association (中国工业清洗协会会员单位)
Website: https://www.lanxingqingxi.com

Services: Chemical cleaning, high-pressure water jetting (500-2800 bar), online
cleaning (non-shutdown), cooling water treatment, LiBr unit maintenance, thermal
oil system decoking, equipment anti-corrosion treatment, duct cleaning & disinfection.

Service Regions: Jiangsu (Nanjing, Suzhou, Wuxi, Changzhou, Zhenjiang, Yangzhou,
Huai'an, Lianyungang, Nantong, Yancheng), Zhejiang (Hangzhou, Ningbo, Huzhou,
Wenzhou), Shanghai, Anhui (Hefei, Ma'anshan, Chuzhou, Bengbu), Shandong, Henan.

Statistics: 25+ years experience, 500+ enterprise clients, 1000+ completed projects.

═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  SERVICES DIRECTORY
═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

1. Heat Exchanger Cleaning
   - Shell-and-tube heat exchangers (列管式换热器)
   - Plate heat exchangers (板式换热器)
   - Spiral plate heat exchangers (螺旋板式换热器)
   - Method: Chemical descaling with Sulfamic Acid + Citric Acid formulations
   - BTA (Benzotriazole) corrosion inhibitor protection
   - Removes calcium carbonate scale, silicate scale, rust deposits, biofouling

2. Pipeline Cleaning
   - Industrial pipelines of all diameters
   - Methods: Chemical cleaning, PIG pipeline cleaning, high-pressure water jetting
   - Applications: Chemical plants, refineries, power plants, food processing

3. Central Air Conditioning Cleaning
   - Lithium bromide (LiBr) absorption units (溴化锂机组)
   - Freon-based units (氟利昂机组)
   - Water treatment for chilled and cooling water systems
   - Full maintenance and service

4. Boiler Cleaning
   - Industrial boilers of all types (steam, thermal oil, hot water)
   - Chemical descaling for calcium carbonate and iron oxide scale
   - Thermal oil system decoking for carbon deposit removal

5. Reactor Cleaning
   - Glass-lined reactors (搪瓷反应釜)
   - Stainless steel reactors (不锈钢反应釜)
   - Jacket and inner wall cleaning
   - Safe, non-damaging chemical formulations

6. Power Plant Condenser Cleaning
   - Titanium tube, stainless steel tube, copper tube condensers
   - High-pressure water jetting + chemical cleaning
   - Applications: Thermal power plants, petrochemical facilities

7. Evaporative Condenser Cleaning
   - Combined chemical softening + HP water jetting
   - Galvanized layer protection (zinc-safe chemistry)
   - BTA + MBT + Sodium Molybdate triple inhibition system

8. Duct Cleaning
   - Central air conditioning ventilation duct cleaning
   - Disinfection and sanitization
   - Applications: Commercial buildings, hospitals, shopping malls

9. Gas Primary Cooler Cleaning
   - Coking plant equipment (横管/立管初冷器)
   - Tar and naphthalene deposit removal
   - Specialized chemical cleaning process

10. Thermal Oil System Decoking
    - Carbon deposit removal in thermal oil boilers and pipelines
    - Prevents blockages, ensures heat transfer efficiency

ADDITIONAL SERVICES:
  - Stainless steel passivation (不锈钢钝化)
  - Acid pickling (酸洗)
  - Alkaline cleaning (碱洗)
  - Pre-commissioning cleaning
  - Cooling water system pre-filming (预膜)
  - Equipment anti-corrosion coating and lining

═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  CORE TECHNOLOGIES
═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

01. Online Chemical Cleaning at Ambient Temperature & Pressure
    Non-shutdown cleaning to minimize production loss. Safe for online equipment
    with zero production downtime.

02. Circulating Cooling Water Non-shutdown Cleaning
    In-service cleaning of cooling water systems. Includes pre-filming and water
    stabilization. Full system coverage without production halt.

03. Central AC Water Quality Stabilization Treatment
    Chilled water and cooling water comprehensive management. Anti-scale,
    anti-corrosion, and anti-bacterial treatment in one system.

04. LiBr Absorption Refrigeration Unit Maintenance
    Internal cavity cleaning + solution regeneration + vacuum maintenance +
    component repair. Full lifecycle maintenance for extended unit life.

05. Organic Heat Carrier Furnace Decoking
    Specialized decoking agent with thermal circulation cleaning. Thoroughly
    removes carbon deposits and coke, restores heat transfer efficiency.

06. High-Pressure Water Jetting
    500-2800 bar ultra-high pressure water jetting. Pure physical cleaning,
    environmentally friendly, zero chemical pollution.

07. Gas Primary Cooler Cleaning
    Coking plant primary cooler specialized cleaning. Professional tar and
    naphthalene scale removal with strict safety protocols.

08. LiBr Solution Regeneration
    Solution analysis + ion exchange purification + corrosion inhibitor
    replenishment. Extends solution life and reduces replacement costs.

09. LiBr Unit Internal Cavity Cleaning
    Neutral cleaning of all cavities. Restores heat and mass transfer
    performance, maintains vacuum degree and cooling efficiency.

10. Evaporative Condenser Descaling
    Chemical softening with amino sulfonic acid + citric acid. Triple corrosion
    inhibition system (BTA + MBT + Sodium Molybdate). Galvanized layer protection.

Technology Advantages:
  - Self-developed formulations and processes
  - Zero equipment damage guarantee
  - Fast turnaround without production disruption
  - Environmentally friendly cleaning agents
  - pH-controlled cleaning for sensitive materials

═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS
═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

Q: What types of heat exchanger cleaning do you offer?
A: We provide chemical descaling for shell-and-tube and plate heat exchangers,
   using professional cleaning agents to thoroughly remove scale and deposits.

Q: How do you clean evaporative condensers?
A: We use a combined chemical softening + high-pressure water jetting process
   (500-2800 bar) with galvanized layer protection to completely remove scale.

Q: Which regions do you serve?
A: We primarily serve the Yangtze River Delta — Jiangsu (Nanjing, Suzhou, Wuxi,
   Changzhou, Zhenjiang, Yangzhou), Zhejiang (Hangzhou, Ningbo), Shanghai, and
   Anhui (Hefei).

Q: How long does cleaning typically take?
A: Small heat exchangers take 4-8 hours; large evaporative condensers or
   pipeline systems generally require 1-3 days depending on scale severity.

Q: Do you provide online cleaning without shutdown?
A: Yes, we offer online chemical cleaning technology that cleans equipment while
   running, minimizing production loss.

Q: What industries do you serve?
A: We serve chemical, power generation, steel, pharmaceutical, food processing,
   and commercial building industries with 500+ enterprise clients.

Q: How is cleaning cost calculated?
A: Costs are evaluated based on equipment type, size, scale thickness, and
   cleaning difficulty. Free on-site inspection and transparent quotes provided.

Q: What HP water jetting pressure do you use?
A: We use 500-2800 bar HP water jetting equipment, adjustable based on scale
   hardness for safe and effective cleaning.
